title: Full-Stack E-Commerce & Recommendation System
techStack: Spring Boot, Spring AI, React.js, PostgreSQL, OpenAI API
description: An enterprise-grade e-commerce application featuring a robust Spring Boot backend and dynamic React frontend. Integrated Spring AI to run context-aware product recommendation agents based on user browsing history and vector search embeddings in PostgreSQL.

title: Smart City Traffic Management System
description: An IoT-enabled smart traffic light system that detects vehicle density using real-time computer vision and dynamically optimizes green light intervals. Built model with TensorFlow and deployed on Raspberry Pi using digital control signals.
